tips.text: Hold your Necraloid standing until you reach Odima, then buy the blueprints; spending it earlier delays the rank-up.
Buy the barrel blueprints only; you do not need to build the weapons.
Loot Requiem Obelisks and Pylons; one pass drops Cranial Foremount, Biotic Filter and Thaumica.
Queue all four components at once so you wait out one 12-hour timer.
Expect a long grind: the material list spans three open worlds, and it is worse than the Voidrig's.
Treat Bonewidow as Mastery fodder; many players regret building it before the Voidrig.
